motion.reason: fewer than three stations in the contiguous falling phase

scope_note: A construction check on a finite marched collar. It does not measure the actual universe. Holding a result across a change of one construction parameter shows it is not an accident; it does not make it physical.

sweep.what_does_not_hold: The relaxation after the peak does not. The final amplitude as a fraction of the peak runs from about 0.65 to about 0.92 and tracks how long the march continued past the peak rather than the release radius, so the runs do not settle it and no relaxed value is claimed. The width compression also does not hold: it grows with release radius, so it is a property of how far the shell fell, not a fixed factor.
sweep.what_holds: The compression gain and the rise time both hold across the sweep: the density peak at the inner boundary grows by about a fifth and reaches its peak about four fifths of a time unit after arrival, at every release radius tried. Holding a result across a change of one construction parameter shows it is not an accident of one run.

what_this_measures: Whether the compression measured at one release radius is a property of the construction or an accident of one run. Packet width, spectrum, chart, mass ratio and source strength are held fixed; only the release radius moves.
